environment.accessibility_startup: GNOME_ACCESSIBILITY=1 and owned Firefox accessibility.force_disabled=-1 before startup; Firefox PID observed on desktop AT-SPI bus.

method.speech: Actual Orca Speech Dispatcher backend Speaking <speak> records, XML markup removed and entities decoded; local timestamps retained. This is generated speech output, not an audio recording or an inference from ARIA.
method.input: Native AT-SPI key synthesis through the owned X11 Firefox window, checked by foreground PID before each key. WebDriver selected controls and submitted real forms; it did not fabricate accessibility events or speech.
method.settings: Private Orca configuration/data; GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory. Temporary runtime speech rate and SayAllOnLoad settings were process-local. No software installed.
method.privacy: Synthetic records only. No login code, Cookie, CSRF, raw request, browser profile or private debug log retained.

transcripts.scope: Accepted for unchanged non-live pages. The missing live announcement in this same recording is a preserved product failure.

limitations: Validation summary and conflict notice were discovered with native browse navigation; automatic alert announcement or automatic alert focus was not established.

Initial Say All and table-jump observations skipped the caption. Native linear Down navigation subsequently spoke the caption before headers and row content. Repeated footer output after end of document is retained.
A mixed-surface diagnostic overlapped a headless Chrome helper and is excluded from Firefox acceptance.

The status-wrapper-only and JavaScript-order-only prototypes did not close live speech. The final generic live child maps to AT-SPI SECTION, avoiding Orca status-bar UI classification and rapid-event filtering.
No broad accessibility conformance, other screen reader or Windows Edge result is claimed.
preserved_operator_failures: FlatReview PresentObject was attempted before enabling flat review and returned an Orca missing-context error. Enabling flat review produced only table, not caption; neither attempt closed the caption cell.
Restarting Orca without a document activation produced window speech only. Fresh navigation established a Firefox script context.
Clicking a static caption did not reliably move Orca browse position. The accepted caption path uses normal linear Down navigation.
A sign-out selector used /board/sign-out instead of observed /board/logout; no element was found and no request was submitted. The corrected native sign-out succeeded.

cleanup.scope: Owned resources only; no unrelated browser or remote desktop process stopped.
cleanup.ime: This AT continuation did not switch or use an IME. With no focused input after cleanup, Fcitx CurrentInputMethod returned an empty string; the earlier IME lane separately verified keyboard-us restoration.
